text_block_list.text:
New Year's—at a time of year when spirits are renewed,
that same bright voice as always echoed through the room.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, I know it's right at the start of the New Year, but...
Could you set up the calligraphy stuff for me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: When I went to the President's office earlier, everyone from the student council had their 'first calligraphy of the year' on display!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do New Year's calligraphy too!
Let's write our resolutions together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, all done!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My goal is simple:
"To totally beat the Prez to a pulp!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I gotta have at least this much drive, or I'll never surpass the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what kind of resolution did you make?
choice_data_list: I'll make Teio into an emperor!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, I like that!
As a pun it's a bit iffy, but I love it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Trainer, your handwriting is so good!
Hey, swap with mine!
Without giving me a say in the matter, my New Year's calligraphy was swapped out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm gonna become the Emperor
and surpass the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, making me an emperor is fine and all, but what are we actually going to do?
choice_data_list: Building the guts to run all the way to the finish!
Staying in top condition to run your best!
Technical improvement to make the most of your strengths!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~, feels like we're gonna be put through
some intense ascetic training...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, they do say having fighting spirit is crucial in a race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll build up my grit and show everyone
I can become the Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I should rest up properly?
I was all fired up, so that's kind of a letdown~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: “Still, if you get injured or sick, you won't even be able to run at all.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it.
I'll pay close attention to managing my condition too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so basically, you're telling me to polish my technique.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's true that simply training your body
isn't enough to win a race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna come up with my very own special...
super-awesome ultimate move!

While Tokai Teio and I were getting excited
setting our resolutions—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the interruption while you're conversing.
I just wanted to offer my New Year's greetings.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Prez!!
Look, look, we did some New Year's calligraphy too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Make Teio the true Emperor"... Fufu, isn't that wonderful... Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Prex, that's what makes you crack up...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So that one is Trainer's resolution, huh...
Hm...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho, so you claim you'll 'beat me to a pulp'...
Trainer, I'll accept your challenge anytime.
choice_data_list: This isn't what it looks like!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do your best!
And so, a brand-new year began together with Tokai Teio.
